description: Foundation for the GO function study: package scaffold and shared helpers (constants, runtime with no-MPS device resolution and repo-relative paths, pins/write_or_verify, vendored PPI-study helpers with parity test, test fixtures), the typed ontology module with DgzRule replica (gap 2), the go.norm loader with the V1..V6 axiom ladder (gap 2), and the label builder with all design 2.4 checks run on the real BP/MF data (gap 3, gate G1). Plan items 1-4 of plan_go_function.md. No dependency on later FEATs.
steps: Plan item 1: create go_function/__init__.py, constants.py, runtime.py (ROOT, resolve_device('auto'|'cuda'|'cpu') never returning mps, seed_everything, setup_logging, repo_rel), pins.py (sha256_file, csr_sha256, canonical JSON, write_or_verify copied with attribution from go_ppi_domain/withholding.py L221-241, record_pin/verify_pin on results/go_function/protocol_pins.json), vendored.py (jaccard; _counts, two_way_draws, _summarise, two_way_bootstrap, hierarchical_bootstrap, holm, classify_contrast, ci_excludes_0 with FLOOR/ALPHA/UNSTABLE_SHARE/seed as required kwargs), go_function/tests/conftest.py (slow marker via GO_FUNCTION_SLOW=1, needs_dgz skip), fixtures go_function/tests/fixtures/mini.obo and mini.norm; tests test_runtime.py, test_pins.py, test_vendored_parity.py

Plan item 2: go_function/ontology.py per design section 1 (Term, Ontology, parse_obo with typed relations + intersection_of + alt/obsolete + OntologyError with line number + parse_report; ancestors/descendants/parents with TRUE_PATH=('is_a','part_of') and same_namespace; isa_siblings; two_hop; logical_definition; DgzRule ported from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bio-ontology-research-group/deepgozero/main/utils.py read via web_fetch, cited in header). Tests go_function/tests/test_ontology.py on mini.obo

Plan item 3: go_function/normforms.py per design 6.4 (DGZ-compatible parse order, owl:Nothing mapping, fatal checks unparsed==9 and Nothing==30 all NF2 RHS, relation IRI map, select(nf, arm) ladder incl. V3c shared vector). Tests go_function/tests/test_normforms.py incl. slow+needs_dgz real go.norm counts NF1 80942 / NF2 11841 / NF3 11810 / NF4 19594

Plan item 4: go_function/labels.py (vocab from terms.pkl column 'gos', primary(), duplicate columns, A_TP / A_TPnoIPI / A_DGZ direct sets, CSR outputs incl. direct_<split> and direct_extra_<split>, MF protein-binding-only evaluation sets, independent _bfs_closure_tp, checks 1, 2, 3a-3d, 5 of design 2.4); scripts/go_function/pin_inputs.py writing config/go_function/input_hashes.json from dataset/go_function/MANIFEST.json (repo-relative paths) and verifying files; scripts/go_function/build_labels.py --aspect bp|mf --regime TP|DGZ|TPnoIPI|all [--verify-pins] writing preprocess/go_function/<aspect>/labels_<regime>.npz + .json manifest and pins G1-labels / G1-norm. Tests go_function/tests/test_labels.py (planted 3c/3d violations trip; noIPI eval set) + slow DgzRule-vs-prop_annotations on 200 proteins per aspect

Run G1 for real: pin_inputs.py, build_labels.py --aspect mf --regime all, build_labels.py --aspect bp --regime all (background, timeout >= 30 min, memory: never two BP dense matrices). Record counts (DGZ excess, TP-only alt labels ~778 BP / 59 MF train, zero-positive columns) in this FEAT's findings
acceptance_criteria: `cd /Users/olukotunjosh/Downloads/CDCL && GO_FUNCTION_SLOW=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest go_function/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider` passes (incl. vendored parity and real go.norm counts)

findings:
G1 run locally (CPU, no torch), all exits 0; re-runs report "unchanged" (byte-identical); `--verify-pins` passes; no '/Users/' in any written artifact (incl. inside the npz files). GO_FUNCTION_SLOW=1 pytest go_function/tests: 60 passed (incl. vendored parity, real go.norm counts, DgzRule == prop_annotations on 200 fixed train proteins per aspect). git status: new paths only go_function/, scripts/go_function/, config/go_function/ (the other pre-existing modified/untracked files were already there).

REAL COUNTS (pinned DGZ release):
- go.obo: 47,235 [Term] stanzas, 43,791 live, 3,567 obsolete ids (incl. their alt ids), 3,364 alt ids; 0 edges to obsolete parents, 0 edges to alt ids, 0 intersection_of to alt ids.
- go.norm: NF1 80,942 / NF2 11,841 / NF3 11,810 / NF4 19,594; 9 unparsed; owl:Nothing in 30 lines (all NF2 RHS). DGZ rel_index: BFO:0000050=0, RO:0002213=1, RO:0002212=2, RO:0002211=3, BFO:0000066=4, BFO:0000051=5, RO:0002092=6, RO:0002093=7. Zero classes: BP 23,881 (45,262 classes), MF 38,396 (45,264). Ladder (BP): V1 NF1 only; V2 NF3 1,809 / NF4 8,661 (1 rel); V3 = V3c NF3 11,534 / NF4 18,505 (4 rels; V3c 1 shared); V4 = V6 everything, 8 rels. Zero classes per arm (BP) V1 22,435, V2 22,641, V3 23,844, V4 23,881.
- Vocab: BP 21,381 cols, 25 alt cols, all 25 duplicate; MF 6,868 cols, 17 alt cols, 14 duplicate. No column has an obsolete/unknown id.
- Labels (in V) train/valid/test: BP TP 1,924,857 / 225,455 / 211,282; BP DGZ 2,510,367 / 294,663 / 271,618. MF TP 308,346 / 33,963 / 44,130; MF DGZ 377,009 / 41,504 / 52,759; MF TPnoIPI 275,145 / 30,475 / 39,009.
- DGZ excess over TP (check 3c / check 5, sum_p |cols_DGZ \ cols_BFS|): BP train 589,891 (valid 69,758, test 60,883), net +30.4% labels; MF train 71,172 (valid 7,773, test 9,262), net +22.3%. (Spec quoted +66% BP / +31% MF on current GO.)
- TP-only labels (check 3d channels), train: BP PrimAlt 778, AltCols 3,603; MF PrimAlt 59, AltCols 2,450 (valid/test: BP 98/111 PrimAlt, MF 8/8). Check 3d: 0 exceptions on every split.
- Zero-positive columns (D16), train: BP TP 1,048, BP DGZ 676; MF TP 467, MF DGZ 429, MF TPnoIPI 625. Lists for train are in each manifest's `zero_positive_columns_train`; valid/test counts in `splits.<split>.n_zero_positive_columns`.
- A_TP drops (obsolete exp ids): BP train/valid/test 441/65/55, MF 427/41/45; alt ids mapped to primary: BP 913/111/141, MF 78/13/10.
- Proteins with EMPTY TP closure: BP 1,187/163/141, MF 1,010/96/114 (DGZ-rule closure is empty only for 6/1/0 MF). MF TPnoIPI empty: 3,984/418/502.
- DEVIATION / data fact: GO:0005515 never occurs in exp_annotations or annotations of any MF split (it only appears in prop_annotations, via descendants), so the design 2.5 protein-binding-only set is EMPTY on this release: MF TP eval set = all 4,712 test rows; MF TPnoIPI eval set = 4,210 (non-empty TPnoIPI closure). Design 0.2's "1,024 MF train proteins with only GO:0005515" was NOT reproduced (0 found). The TP eval sets include the empty-closure test rows (141 BP, 114 MF) because design 2.5 only requires non-empty closure for TPnoIPI; FEAT-002 (evaluator) should decide/flag whether protein-centric metrics drop them (DGZ evaluates all test rows).

FILES / OUTPUTS:
- config/go_function/input_hashes.json (tracked): {schema, sources:[{manifest, source}], files:{repo-rel path: {sha256, size}}} for all 29 files in dataset/go_function/MANIFEST.json (+ MANIFEST_gate.json entries automatically when that file exists; pin_inputs.py allows only additions, a changed hash is exit 2).
- preprocess/go_function/<aspect>/labels_<regime>.npz + labels_<regime>.json (bp: TP, DGZ; mf: TP, DGZ, TPnoIPI), plus log.txt. results/go_function/protocol_pins.json: pins G1-labels {"<aspect>/labels_<regime>.json": sha256 of manifest bytes} and G1-norm {"go.norm": {sha256, nf1..nf4, unparsed, nothing_lines, rel_index}, "bp_ladder"/"mf_ladder": per-arm counts}.
- npz layout (deviation from design 2.3: no object arrays, no pickle): CSR as <name>_indptr (int64), <name>_indices (int32), <name>_data (uint8), <name>_shape for name in train/valid/test/direct_train/direct_valid/direct_test; direct_extra_<split> stored as direct_extra_<split>_indptr + flat direct_extra_<split>_ids (str); proteins_<split> (str); vocab (str); eval_test (int64 test row indices; TP and TPnoIPI only; BP = all rows). Read with go_function.labels.load_labels(path) -> dict (CSR matrices, direct_extra_<split> as list of tuples, proteins_<split>, vocab, eval_test). Deterministic zip via pins.npz_bytes.
- Manifest keys: schema, aspect, regime, npz, npz_sha256, inputs, ontology_parse_report, vocab{n_columns, vocab_sha256, alt_columns, duplicate_columns, ...}, splits.<split>{n_rows, n_labels, n_zero_positive_columns, n_rows_empty_closure, labels_sha256 (=pins.csr_sha256), direct_sha256, obsolete_dropped, alt_mapped, proteins_sha256, [test: n_eval_rows, n_protein_binding_only]}, zero_positive_columns_train, checks_passed, check_counts, evaluation_set.

API (for later FEATs):
- go_function.runtime: ROOT, FatalError (exit 2), ProtocolStop (exit 3), resolve_device(name in auto|cuda|cpu; 'mps' -> ValueError), seed_everything(seed), setup_logging(name, out_dir=None) (stderr + <out_dir>/log.txt), repo_rel(path)->str (raises outside ROOT), repo_path(rel)->Path.
- go_function.constants: FLOOR, ALPHA, UNSTABLE_SHARE, ANALYSIS_SEED=20261011, RETENTION_SEED(_2), SEEDS, KS, ASPECTS, NAMESPACES, ROOTS, PROTEIN_BINDING, BINDING, EXP_CODES, EXP_CODES_NO_IPI, RELATION_IRIS (go.norm IRI 'BFO:0000050' style -> name), OWL_NOTHING='owl:Nothing', ARMS, RULES, REGIMES, EXIT_OK/FATAL/STOP/REFUSED, PIN_KEYS.
- go_function.pins: sha256_file, sha256_bytes, csr_sha256(m), canonical_json(obj)->bytes (raises on '/Users/' or ROOT), npz_bytes(dict)->bytes, csr_arrays(prefix, m), load_csr(npz, prefix), write_or_verify(out_dir, files) (dir-level, attributed copy), write_or_verify_file(path, data) (single file, for shared dirs), record_pin(key, entries, pins_path=None) (merges; differing existing entry fatal), verify_pin(key, entries, pins_path=None), verify_inputs(rel_paths)->{rel: sha} against config/go_function/input_hashes.json, assert_writable_target(path).
- go_function.vendored: jaccard, _counts, two_way_draws, _summarise(..., *, unstable_share), two_way_bootstrap(X, unit_pack, n_packs, B, *, seed, unstable_share, strata=None), hierarchical_bootstrap(X, B, *, seed, unstable_share, strata=None), holm, classify_contrast(c, *, floor, alpha), ci_excludes_0. (Keyword names are lowercase; no defaults.) Original ANALYSIS_SEED used in parity tests = 20251009.
- go_function.ontology: Term, Ontology(terms, alt_to_primary, obsolete, report; .primary(id)), OntologyError(msg, line), parse_obo(path), parse_report(ont), TRUE_PATH, parents/ancestors(ont, rels=TRUE_PATH, same_namespace=True) (reflexive dict[id, frozenset]), descendants(anc), isa_siblings(ont, t, anc, desc), two_hop(ont, t, anc, desc, rels=TRUE_PATH), logical_definition(ont, t)->(genus, ((rel, cls),...)), DgzRule(obo_path).closure(id)/.prop(ids)/.has_term/.known_ids, is_go_id. Edges to alt parents are mapped to primary (counted); edges to obsolete parents dropped (counted).
- go_function.normforms: NormalForms(nf1,nf2,nf3,nf4,class_index,rel_index,unparsed,n_vocab,nothing_lines,lines,arm; .counts(), .class_ids()), load_normal_forms(path, terms_dict, dgz_compat=True, expected_unparsed=9, expected_nothing=30) (a SubClassOf line matching no form is fatal), select(nf, arm in V1|V2|V3|V3c|V4|V6) (V0/V5 -> ValueError), assert_ladder(nf)->per-arm counts. V3c maps all 4 relations to index 0.
- go_function.labels: SPLITS, Vocab(ids, index, primary, alt_cols, duplicate_cols, primary_to_cols), read_terms(terms_pkl), build_vocab(ids, ont), direct_tp(raw, ont, namespace, counts=None), exp_from_annotations(annotations, codes), tp_closure(direct, anc, root), _bfs_closure_tp, tp_cols(closure, vocab), dgz_cols(closure, vocab), check_3a/3c/3d, Context.build(aspect, ont, dgz, vocab_ids) (.anc, .parent_cols, .pb_only), build_split(ctx, split, proteins, exp, annotations, prop, regimes)->SplitResult, load_split_columns(pkl), regime_arrays, regime_manifest, load_labels(path), raise_on_failures.
- CLIs: scripts/go_function/pin_inputs.py; scripts/go_function/build_labels.py --aspect bp|mf --regime TP|DGZ|TPnoIPI|all [--verify-pins] (TPnoIPI with bp -> exit 2). Runtime: MF ~9 s, BP ~13 s, BP peak RSS ~0.8 GB (CSR built directly, no dense matrix).

OTHER NOTES: check 3b also asserts the stored TP row equals the BFS column set; check 3d is applied to (stored row ∪ cols_BFS); checks 3a-3d also run for TPnoIPI (counts prefixed noipi_ in check_counts). DGZ source read via web_fetch: utils.py (Ontology) and deepgozero.py (load_normal_forms) from raw.githubusercontent.com/bio-ontology-research-group/deepgozero/main.
